axes.name: input_byte_type
axes.rationale: Target loads each record length with `sub ah,ah`, so unsigned char is expected; signed char is a controlled ABI/codegen alternative.

axes.name: table_cursor_type
axes.rationale: Target advances a two-byte table cursor but stores each entry as a far pointer; near versus far table-pointer declarations discriminate cursor segment handling.

axes.name: copy_loop
axes.rationale: Target performs a computed-length copy while advancing separate source and destination pointers; test the two ordinary C loop spellings.

spec.semantic_summary: Bounded declaration/copy batch: near versus far cursor to far-pointer table entries; signed versus unsigned source bytes; and two pointer-copy-loop spellings. These test the target’s two-byte table cursor and zero-extended record lengths.
binding_evidence: Target code writes offset and segment words to each table entry while advancing the table cursor by four bytes.
Target byte lengths are zero-extended before arithmetic.
Target copy body uses REP MOVSW/MOVSB over a computed record length.
